---
title: Update Vendor
description: Update an existing vendor metadata entry by submitting the complete vendor object.
api: "PUT /api/vendors/"
---

Updates an existing vendor metadata entry. The request body must carry the vendor `id`; the vendor name must remain unique among other non-deleted vendors.

This is a full-record update: the submitted object is saved as-is, so optional fields omitted from the body are written back as empty or unset. `updated_time` is refreshed by the server; the updated record is returned in `data`.

Requires **Admin** permissions. See [Authentication](/nookmux/api/management/auth) for how to authenticate management API requests.

## Request

<RequestExample>

```bash cURL
curl --request PUT \
  --url 'https://your-nookmux-domain/api/vendors/' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  --header 'New-Api-User: 1' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "OpenAI",
  "description": "OpenAI models",
  "icon": "openai",
  "data_retention_days": 30,
  "training_opt_out": true,
  "status": 1
}'
```

</RequestExample>

### Body

<ParamField path="body.id" type="integer" required>
  ID of the vendor to update. Requests with an ID of `0` (or without an ID) are rejected.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path="body.name" type="string" required>
  Vendor name, unique among other non-deleted vendors; limited to 128 characters.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path="body.description" type="string">
  Free-form description.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path="body.icon" type="string">
  Icon name from `@lobehub/icons`, rendered by the frontend; limited to 128 characters.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path="body.data_retention_days" type="integer">
  Data-retention window in days shown on the pricing page (`0` means no retention). Omit to unset the value.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path="body.training_opt_out" type="boolean">
  Whether requests to this vendor are excluded from upstream model training by default (shown on the pricing page). Omit to unset the value.
</ParamField>

<ParamField path="body.status" type="integer" default="1">
  Reserved status field; `1` means enabled.
</ParamField>

## Response

<ResponseExample>

```json 200
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "",
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "OpenAI",
    "description": "OpenAI models",
    "icon": "openai",
    "data_retention_days": 30,
    "training_opt_out": true,
    "status": 1,
    "created_time": 1735689600,
    "updated_time": 1735776000
  }
}
```

</ResponseExample>

### Response fields

<ResponseField name="success" type="boolean" required>
  Whether the vendor was updated.
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="message" type="string" required>
  Error description when `success` is `false`; empty otherwise.
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="data" type="object" required>
  The updated vendor record.

  <Expandable title="vendor structure">
    <ResponseField name="id" type="integer" required>
      Vendor ID.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="name" type="string" required>
      Vendor name.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="description" type="string">
      Free-form description; omitted when empty.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="icon" type="string">
      Icon name from `@lobehub/icons`, rendered by the frontend; omitted when empty.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="data_retention_days" type="integer">
      Data-retention window in days; omitted when unset.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="training_opt_out" type="boolean">
      Whether requests to this vendor are excluded from upstream model training by default; omitted when unset.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="status" type="integer" required>
      Reserved status field; `1` means enabled.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="created_time" type="integer" required>
      Creation time as a Unix timestamp in seconds.
    </ResponseField>
    <ResponseField name="updated_time" type="integer" required>
      Last update time as a Unix timestamp in seconds, refreshed by the server.
    </ResponseField>
  </Expandable>
</ResponseField>

<Note>
Management endpoints return HTTP `200` even on business failures; always check the `success` field. Successful updates are recorded in the admin audit log (vendor module).
</Note>

## Error messages

| Condition | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Invalid request body | The JSON body is missing or malformed |
| Missing vendor ID | The body does not carry a non-zero `id` |
| Vendor name already exists | Another non-deleted vendor already uses the same name |
| Database error, please try again later | Reading the current record, the duplicate-name check, or the save failed; this includes an unknown `id`; see server logs |
